rows.subject: Dienst ruilen
rows.label_reason: Dutch how-to question about swapping shifts, answered by FAQ F03. Reply in Dutch.
rows.pred_reason: The customer asks a standard how-to question about shift swapping, which is fully covered by F03. Priority P4: nothing broken and no risk: how-to, information, idea or spam.
rows.draft_reply:
Hoi,

Om een dienst te ruilen, open je de dienst in de app en tik je op "Ruil aanbieden". Collega's met dezelfde rol kunnen de ruil dan accepteren.

De manager keurt de ruil goed onder Rooster → Verzoeken. Deze goedkeuring staat standaard aan, maar kan eventueel worden uitgeschakeld onder Instellingen → Rooster.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
rows.back_translation_en:
Hi,

To swap a shift, you open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap.

The manager approves the swap under Rota → Requests. This approval is enabled by default, but can optionally be disabled under Settings → Rota.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly

policy_notes: verifier: draft has claims not supported by the help centre
rows.back_translation_en:
Dear,

The Plus subscription costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 employees, this amounts to €150 per month (excluding VAT).

With the Plus subscription, you have unlimited locations, API access, and payroll integrations with Nmbrs, Loket.nl, and AFAS.

You can upgrade at any time via Settings → Subscription. The new price applies from the next invoice.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
